name: my-business-brain
description: A trusted memory for your business inside Claude, in English and Arabic. Keeps what your company knows as plain files in your own folder, each fact with its source and every change logged. Catches clashing facts and edits made behind its back, tells you who was sent an outdated price, briefs you or your team, keeps a journal and dashboard, and puts contract deadlines on your calendar. Confidential details stay in; off-the-record is never stored. By Abraham.

brain_folder.title: Brain folder
brain_folder.description: The folder that holds your business brain (it contains BRAIN.md). Leave empty to use a business-brain folder in the current workspace.

calendar.title: Calendar for Contract Clocks
calendar.description: Where contract deadlines go: google or outlook (through a connected calendar), ics for Apple, Thunderbird, Nextcloud, Proton or any CalDAV calendar, or ask to be asked each time.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Your main currency code, for example AED, USD, EUR or GBP.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Your IANA time zone for calendar events, for example Asia/Dubai or Europe/London. Empty uses local time.

weekend.title: Weekend days
weekend.description: Used to flag deadlines that fall on a weekend.

language.title: Language of record
language.description: Language for journals, briefings, reports and the dashboard: match (the language you write in), english, arabic, or both side by side. Facts are always stored in the language they came in.

capture_mode.title: Remembering facts from conversation
capture_mode.description: ask: offer to remember business facts you mention; auto: remember them and tell you.

session_brief.title: Session brief
session_brief.description: At the start of a session, tell Claude about decisions waiting and contract deadlines coming up (Claude Code and Cowork).

auto_threshold.title: Auto-apply confidence
auto_threshold.description: Small decisions (what to remember, which domain, how sensitive) at or above this confidence are applied automatically and logged. Confidence is corrected by each type's track record, and types that keep being corrected get a stricter bar automatically.

review_threshold.title: Ask-me confidence
review_threshold.description: Decisions between this and the auto-apply confidence are shown to you to confirm; below it, they go to the independent checker or to you.
